milestones.description: Building polish: schematic contents, chest labels, scaffolding cleanup, leftovers, and in-game checks of 0.8 features.
Multiplayer support (e.g. building on servers that allow bots).

issues.title: Building: fill chests, barrels, signs and item frames from the schematic
issues.body:
The Build tab already has the switch *Fill chests/signs/frames*, but it doesn't do anything yet.

- Put the schematic's container contents into placed chests/barrels/furnaces
- Write sign text
- Place item frames with their items
- Items the bot can't get (enchanted/written books, rare items) → stop and ask, like missing blocks

issues.title: Building: go straight to the right chest using item-frame / sign labels
issues.body: When gathering materials, read item frames (and sign text like "Cobble / Stone") on chests to find where an item is stored. Never take the frame's own item. The matching logic exists (`ChestLabels`); it still needs to be used by gathering.

issues.title: Building: remove scaffolding blocks after a build
issues.body: Blocks the bot placed only to reach high spots (dirt/cobble pillars) should be removed when the build is done. The detection logic exists (`ScaffoldTracker`); it still needs to run after a build.

issues.title: Building: put leftover materials back into chests
issues.body: After a build, return unused materials to the chests they came from (or a labeled chest).

issues.title: Built-in schematics
issues.body: Ship a set of built-in `.litematic` files with the mod (in `assets/altoclefplus/schematics/`).

issues.title: In-game check: water safety (cave water, air rescue, door air pocket)
issues.body: Added in 0.8.0, covered by unit tests only so far. Check that the bot avoids wading through cave water, swims up when low on air, and makes a door air pocket under a ceiling.

issues.title: In-game check: background smelting, visible inventory, spare pickaxe
issues.body:
Added in 0.8.x, unit-tested only so far:
- Smelting in the background (mines nearby coal while the furnace works)
- Visible inventory (inventory screen opens while crafting/equipping)
- Spare pickaxe made before the only one breaks

issues.title: In-game check: chest rules, item-frame protection, AltoClef options page, presets
issues.body:
Added in 0.8.0, unit-tested only so far:
- Chest rules (allowed, safe-zone chests, leave at least N)
- Item frames never hit / their block never broken
- AltoClef options in Settings
- Saving a command as a preset with *+*, shift-click to remove

issues.title: Multiplayer support
issues.body: Make AltoClef Plus work on servers that allow bots, starting with building.
